high_standard.label: High emetogenic risk
warnings: Caution: metoclopramide with olanzapine may increase extrapyramidal adverse effects.
Dexamethasone may be modified or omitted where the SACT regimen already includes a steroid.
Metoclopramide: adult maximum 10 mg up to TDS (30 mg/day) and maximum treatment duration 5 days under current EMA/Irish product information; avoid prolonged repeated use without review.

local_prescription_items.directions: Take one capsule one hour prior to chemotherapy; bring it to the day ward.
Take one capsule daily for two days starting the day after chemotherapy.
Take once daily for three days starting the day after chemotherapy.
Take one capsule daily for four days starting on the day of chemotherapy.
Rinse 1 mL around the mouth four times daily after meals during the chemotherapy regimen.
Rinse 10 mL around the mouth for at least 1 minute four times daily; expel after rinsing.
Take one tablet three times daily as required.
Take one tablet three times daily as required.
Take 4 mg after the first episode of diarrhoea, then 2 mg after each further episode, to a maximum of 16 mg/day.

high_standard.evidence_update: Current NCCP V8 and MASCC/ESMO 2023 align on four-drug prophylaxis for conventional HEC: NK1 antagonist + 5-HT3 antagonist + dexamethasone + olanzapine.
high_standard.local_adjunct_note: The local CUH source is retained as a reference list, not as the national antiemetic standard. Nystatin/chlorhexidine are displayed as local mouth-care adjuncts, not universal antiemetic or mucositis prophylaxis. Verify current local oral-care policy.

moderate.evidence_update: NCCP V8 retains dexamethasone on days 2–3 for its default moderate-risk schedule. MASCC/ESMO 2023 supports limiting dexamethasone to day 1 for most MEC and recommends NK1 + 5-HT3 + steroid for carboplatin AUC ≥5 and for women <50 receiving oxaliplatin. Treat this as an evidence overlay requiring local/NCCP reconciliation rather than silently changing the national default.
moderate.local_adjunct_note: The local CUH source is retained as a reference list, not as the national antiemetic standard. Nystatin/chlorhexidine are displayed as local mouth-care adjuncts, not universal antiemetic or mucositis prophylaxis. Verify current local oral-care policy.

interaction_rules.message: Avoid routine proton-pump inhibitor co-administration with erlotinib. Omeprazole reduced erlotinib AUC by 46% and Cmax by 61% in the SmPC interaction study. If acid suppression is essential, review the current SmPC and oncology-pharmacy advice rather than automatically substituting another acid-suppressing medicine.

vesicant_dna.general_action: Localise and neutralise; cold compress is generally used. Apply drug-specific antidote guidance and local policy.

vesicant_non_dna.label: Vesicant - non-DNA binding
vesicant_non_dna.general_action: Disperse and dilute; warm compress is generally used. Apply drug-specific antidote guidance and local policy.
